items.text: Reduced server stall when crafting workshop-skinned items for the first time after a restart or Steam definitions update (200 ms → 0.07 ms).
Eliminated ~0.7 s server freeze when reskinning repair benches after a Steam item definitions update (1275 ms → 0.66 ms).
Radiation watergun streams now display the correct color for rad‑water, fixing a visual bug that hid radiation indication.
Prototype Workbench Upgrade success chance changed to 25 % (previously always failed), increasing average blueprint consumption from 2.67 to 4 and adding a failure sound.
Cows now follow the player smoothly instead of moving slowly and erratically when being led.
Scientist boat groups now spawn every 5‑8 hours, each lasting 30‑60 minutes before egress.
Players can no longer take the PT boat out of the deep sea, matching behavior of other boats.
Animals now flee when attacked from a distance and no longer sleep, fixing previous AI issues.
Sheep feeding bug fixed: sheep no longer starve despite a trough; feeding times are now synchronized with cows.
AI Sleep Zones now work correctly again after a race‑condition bug prevented zones outside BaseEntity from initializing.

Improved targeting logic: scientists only turn when they can see the player, swap to new targets if the current one is obstructed or hidden, give up after chasing too long or beyond a set distance, and bail out when no valid target remains.
Cows can now satisfy their light requirement using lamps.
Cows no longer clip through walls when lying down.
Scientist boats will now turn to face a target player if none of the crew can see them.
Default item pool increased from 512 to 2,048, reducing overflow and allowing larger loot batches.
Underwater crates now contain blueprint fragments and pages, matching other loot pools.
Adjusted random gutting bonuses for certain fish; 20% chance now yields a blueprint fragment instead of 8 cloth.
Animal fences and gates can be placed more easily on sloped terrain.
Ramp deployment line‑of‑sight now includes an extra check, fixing blue LOS blockage.
Sprinklers no longer skip splash effects, briefly lose fuel type, or cause radwater tint flicker.
Radwater splashes now use green effect variants; sprinklers start with correct water type; added viewmodel and water gun/pistol support.
Bags assigned to you while dead now appear on the map immediately, preventing them from disappearing after rejoining.
AI Sleep Zones now work correctly, restoring proper AI sleeping behavior.

Boat scientist AI now only attempts turns when the player is visible, switches targets if the current one is obstructed, rotates to face players when unseen, and gives up chasing after a maximum distance or time or when shot.
Sheep feeding bug fixed so they no longer starve at troughs, and cows can satisfy their light requirement using lamps.
Cows no longer clip through walls when lying down, and animal fences and gates can now be placed more easily on sloped terrain.
Water Purifier no longer incorrectly increases the garbage stack before removal, preventing inventory overflow.
Default item pool size increased from 512 to 2,048 to stop overflow issues.

Gutting bonuses for catfish, orange roughy, salmon, and small shark adjusted; 20% chance to get 8 cloth replaced with 20% chance to get a blueprint fragment, and blueprint fragments/pages added to underwater crates.
Fixed sprinklers skipping splash effects, temporary null fuel type, and radwater tint flicker on circuit/output changes; sprinklers now start with proper water.
Radwater splashes now use green effect variants; added support for water gun and water pistol with viewmodel integration.

2026-10-26.summary:
### AI & NPC Behavior
- AI Sleep Zones now work correctly, restoring proper AI sleeping behavior.
- Boat scientist AI now only attempts turns when the player is visible, switches targets if the current one is obstructed, rotates to face players when unseen, and gives up chasing after a maximum distance or time or when shot.

### Livestock & Farming
- Sheep feeding bug fixed so they no longer starve at troughs, and cows can satisfy their light requirement using lamps.
- Cows no longer clip through walls when lying down, and animal fences and gates can now be placed more easily on sloped terrain.

### Item & Crafting
- Water Purifier no longer incorrectly increases the garbage stack before removal, preventing inventory overflow.

### Loot & Item Pool
- Default item pool size increased from 512 to 2,048 to stop overflow issues.
- Gutting bonuses for catfish, orange roughy, salmon, and small shark adjusted; 20% chance to get 8 cloth replaced with 20% chance to get a blueprint fragment, and blueprint fragments/pages added to underwater crates.

### Sprinklers & Radwater
- Fixed sprinklers skipping splash effects, temporary null fuel type, and radwater tint flicker on circuit/output changes; sprinklers now start with proper water.
- Radwater splashes now use green effect variants; added support for water gun and water pistol with viewmodel integration.

items.text: Animal repellant buff now only affects sharks (they flee) and bee swarms (they won't chase); bulls and rams ignore the buff and will neither flee nor charge.
Chickens on the tutorial island no longer act aggressively.
Sunflower seed-stage plants can now be cleared reliably with a melee weapon.
Child livestock can leave their mother's leash radius to eat from a trough, preventing them from getting stuck hungry in pens.
Building planner now shows the specific blocker name instead of a generic "Cannot build in this area" message.
Ramp placement improved: aiming at the center of a foundation now places ramps correctly.
Wrapping paper can no longer be filled with water, preventing unintended item behavior.

2026-10-25.summary:
### Animals & AI
- Animal repellant buff now only affects sharks (they flee) and bee swarms (they won't chase); bulls and rams ignore the buff and will neither flee nor charge.
- Chickens on the tutorial island no longer act aggressively.

### Farming
- Sunflower seed-stage plants can now be cleared reliably with a melee weapon.
- Child livestock can leave their mother's leash radius to eat from a trough, preventing them from getting stuck hungry in pens.

### Building & UI
- Building planner now shows the specific blocker name instead of a generic "Cannot build in this area" message.
- Ramp placement improved: aiming at the center of a foundation now places ramps correctly.

### Bug Fixes
- Wrapping paper can no longer be filled with water, preventing unintended item behavior.

items.text: Shears now harvest 25% more wool, have double durability (200), and deal reduced damage (4 slash + 4 stab), making them a more efficient wool‑gathering tool.
Network packet batching reduces latency and improves responsiveness; can be toggled at runtime.
Fixed viewmodel camera bone positioning, correcting misaligned weapon view.

2026-10-24.summary:
### Tools & Crafting
- Shears now harvest 25% more wool, have double durability (200), and deal reduced damage (4 slash + 4 stab), making them a more efficient wool‑gathering tool.

### Gameplay & Balance
- Network packet batching reduces latency and improves responsiveness; can be toggled at runtime.
- Fixed viewmodel camera bone positioning, correcting misaligned weapon view.
